match_pattern_against_value: match a value against a pattern using the match function and return a MatchResult
convert_to_pattern_object: convert a literal value like an int or string into a PatternBase object using to_pattern
match_every_combinator: build a pattern that succeeds only if all given subpatterns match the test value
match_any_combinator: build a pattern that succeeds if any one of the given subpatterns matches the test value
negate_pattern: negate an existing pattern so that successes become failures and failures become successes
